This '''Trainer'''<ref>The Trainer is referred to by the pronoun ''his'' in official materials from the studio that made Bidoof's Big Stand. (https://artineering.io/blog/spotlight/bidoof)</ref> is a central character in ''[[Bidoof's Big Stand]]''. 

==History==
{{spoilers}}
The Trainer appeared for the first time saving {{p|Bidoof}} from the attack of a {{p|Staraptor}} and, after much insistence from Bidoof, he ended up giving in and capturing her for his [[Party|team]]. During his {{pkmn|journey}}, the Trainer had a habit of using Bidoof to cross obstacles and rewarded her each time with an [[Oran Berry]]. On one of these occasions, Bidoof was used to open a cave exit where a wild {{p|Gengar}} appeared, so the Trainer quickly replaced her with {{p|Lucario}}. This made Bidoof start to feel bored of doing these actions.

Eventually, the Trainer reached the [[Pokémon League]] finals, where his team was completely defeated in a [[Full Battle]], forcing him to use Bidoof in battle. Encouraging Bidoof to use her special [[move]]s, Bidoof managed to defeat a {{p|Golem}} and a Staraptor, thus making the Trainer the winner of the competition. The victory make Bidoof finally receive recognition from its Trainer.

In the short's epilogue, Trainer was seen taking Bidoof to see its old group of his kind, bringing some foods to her on a beach and taking some pictures with her.

|desc={{p|Lucario}} is this Trainer's first known Pokémon. Lucario was first seen saving Bidoof from a {{p|Staraptor}}'s attack. After the battle, Lucario and the Trainer exchanged a high five, the sight of which made Bidoof want to join their [[Party|team]]. Whenever the Trainer would withdraw Bidoof in a situation where battling was necessary, he would typically send Lucario out in her place. During the Pokémon League, Lucario was defeated by a {{p|Golem}}, forcing the Trainer to send out Bidoof.

In the short's epilogue, Bidoof and Lucario were seen eating some {{Berries}} together.

Lucario's only known move is {{m|Aura Sphere}}.}}
{{TrainerPoké
|trainer=Trainer
|pkmn=Bidoof
|type1=Normal
|gender=female
|img=Trainer and Bidoof.png
|cap=Trainer's Bidoof
|epnum=Bidoof's Big Stand
|epname=Bidoof's Big Stand
|desc={{p|Bidoof}} is the main character of ''[[Bidoof's Big Stand]]''. Before meeting her Trainer, Bidoof lived in a group with others of her kind, and often unintentionally caused them problems. One day, after angering the others, Bidoof wandered away, and upon attempting to eat an Oran Berry she found, she was attacked by a flock of {{p|Starly}}, and then by a {{p|Staraptor}}. Before the Staraptor could finish her off, she was saved by a Trainer and his {{p|Lucario}}. Seeing the bond that the two shared, Bidoof convinced the Trainer to catch her.

During the journey, Bidoof was often sent out only to clear a path and when the need for battle arose, the Trainer was quick to switch her out for Lucario. As time went on, Bidoof became more and more bored with her role on the Trainer's team. One day, the Trainer sent out Bidoof, who realized she was in a real {{pkmn|battle}} in the [[Pokémon League]]. Initially afraid, Bidoof was encouraged by her Trainer to go ahead. Using the same move she used to clear paths for her Trainer, Bidoof was able to defeat a {{p|Golem}}, and afterward, she was able to confront her fears by defeating the opponent's final Pokémon, a {{p|Staraptor}}. This victory meant her Trainer won the Pokémon League, and in celebration, he finally gave Bidoof the same high five she had seen him give Lucario.

In the short's epilogue, Bidoof was shown showing off her Trophy to the other Bidoof in her old home, receiving credit for her victory in the League.

Bidoof is housed in a [[Nest Ball]].

Bidoof's known moves are {{m|Cut}}, {{m|Rock Smash}}, and {{m|Rollout}}.}}
